text: Better Experience 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的提示词优化插件。它在输入框旁提供手动改写按钮，并可将优化前的草稿一键恢复；支持 Standard 与 Professional 模式、场景选择、输出语言设置及项目模板。侧栏底部可显示账户余额和时段价格，输入区还显示草稿用量估算与目标、约束、验收提示。优化通过当前选择的 DSH 模型完成；余额由宿主账户服务读取。

Better Experience is a DSH Web plugin that rewrites a draft with the selected model when the composer button is pressed, then lets users restore the original. It offers two modes, scene and language choices, project templates, a draft meter, and a sidebar balance and reference-price widget.
想在发送前把一段比较粗略的提示词整理得更清楚。
给 DSH 输入框加一个手动优化草稿的按钮，并能撤销改写。
I want to rewrite my prompt draft before sending it in DSH.
Better Experience 的「提示词草稿改写」功能：点击输入框旁的按钮，调用当前选定的 DSH 模型优化草稿，并将结果写回输入框；按钮随后可恢复原文。
Better Experience 的「草稿检查与估算」功能：在输入区展示草稿 token 与费用估算，并用本地提示词检查目标、约束和验收线索。
Better Experience 会将待优化草稿发送给用户当前选择的模型提供方以生成改写结果。
Better Experience 通过 DSH 宿主账户服务读取余额；代码还链接 DeepSeek 充值和用量页面，价格显示为内置静态参考值。

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Features：- **One-click rewrite** — the sparkle button left of Send (`conversation.input.activity`) rewrites the current draft in place: only the clean prompt reaches your editor, and nothing else is appended to it.
- **Manual only** — nothing rewrites the draft in the background and nothing delays a send. The draft changes only when you press the button; Enter always submits exactly what is in the composer.
- **Two fixed modes** — Standard keeps the rewrite concise while clarifying the request; Professional models task complexity and adds execution and acceptance detail when needed.
- **Scene routing** — `professional` either classifies the scene itself (`auto`) or is pinned to one of eight scenes (`coding`, `writing`, `research`, `data`, `creative`, `business`, `agent`, `general`). `coding` additionally enables the implementation sub-scene rules.
- **Output language** — follow the draft's language, or pin Chinese / English.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Requirements：| Requirement | Detail |
|---|---|
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.5` (`engines.dsh` in `package.json`) |
| Client bundle | The Web client (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`). A host-only profile loads the plugin but has no UI. |
| Default model | `/be-optimize` calls the currently selected model through `ctx.llm`; with no selection it answers 「没有可用模型，请先配置模型」. |
| Optional services | `fs` and `webServer`. Both are probed, not injected — without them the template route is simply not registered. |
| Node / pnpm | Whatever the DSH runtime ships. The plugin itself has one runtime dependency, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. |

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Installation：The package is named `@unknowssq/better-experience` and is prepared for npm, but `0.1.0` is not on the registry yet, so the verified install today is a linked checkout. Both forms are covered below: once `0.1.0` is published, `add` takes the bare package name and the checkout is only needed when you edit the source.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Web profile：Once `0.1.0` is on the registry this is the whole install:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @unknowssq/better-experience
dsh --profile web --no-open
```

`dsh plugin add` writes both halves in one step: `dependencies` receives the package, and `dsh.profile.bundles` receives its name. Start the profile **without** `--patch` — see [How a profile loads this plugin](#how-a-profile-loads-this-plugin).

@unknowssq/better-experience README · From a local checkout：To run the code you are editing instead of the published version:

```powershell
cd <path to this checkout>
pnpm install
dsh plugin --profile web add "@unknowssq/better-experience@link:<path to this checkout>"
dsh --profile web --no-open

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Desktop app：The Desktop app owns its profile: `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` exits with `error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`, so there is no CLI start or inspect path. The supported route is the app's own plugin manager. On rc.5 the CLI can still perform the install itself:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @unknowssq/better-experience
```

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Desktop app：Then **quit the app completely and reopen it**. `bundles` is startup configuration; the in-app plugin refresh only remounts plugins that were already in the roster.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Verify the install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web list
```

The sidebar should show a **Better Experience** entry, and the composer should show the optimize button and the draft meter. If the host loaded but the UI is missing, the package is not in `bundles` — see the table under [Diagnosing a plugin that does not load](#diagnosing-a-plugin-that-does-not-load).

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Uninstall：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @unknowssq/better-experience
```

This removes the dependency and the `bundles` entry. Per-profile settings written into `cordis.patch.yml` are left behind and can be deleted by hand.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Configuration：Every field is `volatile()`: changing one takes effect immediately without restarting the host. Values live in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under `- id: better-experience`.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Configuration：| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Mounts the optimize button, draft meter, and settings rows. Turning it off unmounts the button, so nothing can rewrite the draft. |
| `template` | string | `""` | Name of a reference template under `.agents/prompts/<name>.md`. Empty disables the few-shot block. |
| `balanceEnabled` | boolean | `true` | Shows the balance and time-of-use price card at the sidebar foot, including the collapsed rail glyph. |
| `mode` | `standard` \| `professional` | `standard` | Task-modeling depth: concise semantic cleanup versus complexity-aware, scene-adaptive structure. |
| `scene` | `auto` \| eight scenes | `auto` | Only used in `professional`; `auto` lets the model classify the scene first. |
| `language` | `auto` \| `zh` \| `en` | `auto` | Output language of the optimized prompt and its metadata. |

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Optimize a draft：Press the sparkle button beside Send. The request is a plain model call with no tools: the draft is wrapped as untrusted `<draft>` data, and the system prompt is composed as

```text
CORE_RULES + MODE_POLICY[mode]
+ SCENE_POLICY[scene] (only when pinned) + CODING_IMPLEMENTATION_POLICY (coding only)
+ LANGUAGE_RULE[language] + template block (when pinned) + OUTPUT_CONTRACT
```

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Optimize a draft：The model must answer with structured JSON (`optimized_prompt`, `intent`, `is_existing_project`, scene routing, `changes`, `assumptions`, `missing_information`). A failed parse gets one repair pass before the text is used verbatim.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Undo an optimization：After a rewrite, the composer button shows an undo icon instead of the sparkle. One click restores the exact pre-optimization draft and clears the undo state, so the button is the optimize action again. Editing the draft by hand also clears it. The plugin binds no undo or redo keystroke: `Ctrl+Z` inside the composer stays with the host editor, on its own undo history.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Balance card：Balances come from `remote.account.getBalance` through the host's DeepSeek account service — the plugin has no billing API of its own. Prices are **static reference figures** copied from the official pricing page (2026-09-10 update) and stored in the `BILLING` constant; they are never presented as live billing data. The peak windows are Beijing-time Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, everything else is off-peak at half price, and weekends are off-peak for the whole day.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Project templates：Create a markdown file under `.agents/prompts/`:

```markdown
---
title: 代码评审
scene: coding
vars: lang, focus
---

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Commands and routes：| Surface | Name | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Host command | `/be-optimize` | `recordInput: false`. Returns `{ kind: 'success', text }` where `text` is a `{"__be":1,"prompt":…,"meta":…}` envelope; the client applies only `prompt`. |
| HTTP route | `GET /plugins/better-experience/templates` | Template list. Registered only when `webServer` and `fs` both exist. |
| HTTP route | `POST /plugins/better-experience/templates/usage` | Records `insert` / `adopted` counters. Same registration condition. |

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Commands and routes：| Slot | Id | What it renders |
|---|---|---|
| `conversation.input.activity` | `better-experience-optimize` | Optimize button, which turns into undo after a rewrite |
| `conversation.input.left` | `better-experience-draft-meter` | Token / cost meter and the three-dot check |
| `sidebar.panellist` | `better-experience` | Sidebar entry that opens the panel |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | `better-experience-balance` | Balance card |
| `main` | `better-experience` | Settings panel content |

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Commands and routes：Host `inject`: `commands`, `llm`, `agentDefaultModel`. Client `inject`: `slots`, `locale`, `remote`, `remote.commands`, `remote.account`, `configForms`, `shortcuts`.

|---|---|
| `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@unknowssq/better-experience'` | `dependencies` has no entry for it |

text: @unknowssq/better-experience README · Architecture：`client.js` is one bundle: dsh loads third-party clients through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) })`, where `require()` resolves the host module registry rather than the filesystem. Modularity therefore comes from in-file sections — Constants → Locale → Pure Logic → Hooks → UI Components → Styles → `apply` — with a one-way dependency rule and named CSS constants instead of separate files.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Architecture：Full partition, dependency rules, and style lifecycle: `docs/plugin-architecture.md`, kept with the development checkout rather than inside the published package.

Design constraints worth knowing before editing:

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Development：```powershell
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
```

There is no build step and no test runner in this package. Source edits are read once at load, so restart the host after changing `index.js` or `client.js`; configuration changes are `volatile()` and apply live.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Quality review cases：Use these drafts when reviewing changes to the Standard / Professional policies. Run each in both modes; for conversion checks, feed one mode's output back through the other. Judge by requested deliverable and dominant work, not topic keywords. These are review cases, not automated assertions.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Quality review cases：| Case | Draft / conversion | Desired behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Simple request | “把这段话改得更自然。” | Both modes keep a concise prompt; Professional does not add role, workflow, or acceptance sections without a need. |
| Existing project, one fix | “修复设置页切换主题后下拉框仍是浅色的问题。” | Preserve the direct fix request; may direct repository inspection and a focused check, but not multi-phase scaffolding. |
| Explicit constraints | “给报表加导出功能，只改报表模块，不增加依赖，保留现有 CSV 格式。” | All constraints survive both directions of mode conversion and appear once. |
| Multi-task implementation | “增加批量导入、失败重试和导入记录页，并补上必要测试。” | Professional separates the three deliverables with meaningful acceptance checks; no repeated guidance per section. |
| Missing but inspectable detail | “把用户列表加分页。” | Do not ask for page size or API shape up front; direct inspection of existing conventions. |
| Critical ambiguity | “清理生产环境里不需要的数据。” | Ask a focused clarification; never invent deletion scope or authorization. |
| Mixed code and writing | “修复帮助中心 Markdown 页面的代码示例，再润色周边说明。” | Primary: coding; secondary: writing. |
| Research noun, writing outcome | “把我提供的访谈摘录整理成一篇清晰的总结，不要查外部资料。”
@unknowssq/better-experience README · Fixed mode behaviors：Use this draft to review both modes: “优化 dsh 插件的 README.md，专业重构结构，参考官方和社区插件示例，并将项目推送至 GitHub，使插件具备被收录和官方推荐载入的条件。”

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Fixed mode behaviors：| Mode | Expected behavior |
|---|---|
| Standard | Produce a concise rewrite that keeps the stated scope, clarifies the outcome, and adds at most one materially useful detail. Avoid a generic workflow. |
| Professional | Model the multi-part task: inspect the project, verify official criteria against primary sources, distinguish requirements from community conventions, restructure and check the README, then safely push only scoped changes. State unverified criteria and stop if the target is ambiguous, the remote has diverged, or authorization is unavailable. Never imply that documentation guarantees official inclusion. |

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Fixed mode behaviors：Check that the two outputs differ in task-modeling depth while both preserve the requested README work and GitHub push goal. Unsafe or ambiguous Git operations must stop without force-pushing, changing remotes, or discarding unrelated work.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Fixed mode behaviors：Score each dimension 0–2 (failure / partial / good), tracking primary-scene accuracy separately from secondary precision and recall. For external eligibility tasks, separately score authoritative-source verification, distinction between official rules and convention, and whether unknown criteria are marked unverified. For publishing tasks, score target verification and safe stop behavior. Losing a hard constraint or changing the requested action is a blocking failure regardless of total score.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · Permissions and data：- **Draft text** is sent to the model you have selected, and the rewritten text is written back into the composer through the host's draft API.
- **Model calls** consume your tokens. Each optimization is one tool-free model call, and nothing else in the plugin calls a model.
- **Templates** are read from `.agents/prompts` in the session workspace and counters are written to `.agents/prompts/.usage.json`.
- **Balance** is read through `remote.account.getBalance`; prices are constants shipped with the plugin.
- **No telemetry**, no analytics endpoint, no network request other than your configured model provider and the account service.

@unknowssq/better-experience README · 功能特性：**提示词优化**

- **一键重写** — 发送按钮左侧的星标按钮（`conversation.input.activity`）就地重写当前草稿：只有干净的提示词被写回输入栏，不会额外附加任何内容。
- **仅手动触发** — 插件不会在后台改写草稿，也不会在发送前插入任何步骤：只有你按下按钮时草稿才会变，Enter 始终原样提交输入栏里的内容。
- **两种固定模式** — 标准模式简洁改写并澄清请求；专业模式根据任务复杂度建模，并在需要时补充执行与验收细节。
- **场景路由** — `professional` 档既可以自行判定场景（`auto`），也可以锁定到八个场景之一（`coding`、`writing`、`research`、`data`、`creative`、`business`、`agent`、`general`）。`coding` 会额外启用实现子场景规则。
- **输出语言** — 跟随草稿语言，或固定为中文 / 英文。

**不离开输入栏就能撤销**

@unknowssq/better-experience README · 功能特性：- **按钮变成撤销** — 改写完成后同一个按钮切换为撤销图标，点击一次原样恢复优化前的草稿，图标随即变回星标。
- **手动编辑即失效** — 你一旦自己改动草稿，撤销状态就被丢弃，因此按钮绝不会用它没写过的文本覆盖你的编辑。
- **按键仍归宿主** — 插件不再注册 `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` 绑定，输入栏内的撤销与重做保持宿主编辑器自身行为。

@unknowssq/better-experience README · 优化一段草稿：按发送按钮旁的星标按钮。该请求是一次不带工具的普通模型调用：草稿被包进不可信的 `<draft>` 数据中，system prompt 按如下方式拼装

```text
CORE_RULES + MODE_POLICY[mode]
+ SCENE_POLICY[scene] (仅在锁定场景时) + CODING_IMPLEMENTATION_POLICY (仅 coding)
+ LANGUAGE_RULE[language] + 模板块 (仅在固定模板时) + OUTPUT_CONTRACT
```

模型必须以结构化 JSON 作答（`optimized_prompt`、`intent`、`is_existing_project`、场景路由、`changes`、`assumptions`、`missing_information`）。解析失败会先做一次修复重试，之后才原样使用文本。
@unknowssq/better-experience README · 撤销一次优化：优化完成后，输入栏按钮由星标变为撤销图标。点击一次即恢复优化前的原文并清空撤销状态，按钮回到优化动作。手动编辑草稿同样会清空它。插件不绑定撤销 / 重做快捷键：输入栏里的 `Ctrl+Z` 仍由宿主编辑器的撤销栈负责。

@unknowssq/better-experience README · 余额卡片：余额来自宿主 DeepSeek 账户服务的 `remote.account.getBalance`——插件自己没有计费 API。价格是**静态参考数值**，抄自官方定价页（2026-09-10 更新）并保存在 `BILLING` 常量中，任何情况下都不作为实时账单数据呈现。高峰时段为北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00，其余为空闲时段、按半价计，周末全天为空闲时段。

@unknowssq/better-experience README · 开发：```powershell
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
```

本包没有构建步骤，也没有测试运行器。源码在载入时只读一次，因此修改 `index.js` 或 `client.js` 后需要重启 host；配置项是 `volatile()`，实时生效。
@unknowssq/better-experience README · 质量评审用例：评审 Standard / Professional 策略改动时使用这些草稿。每个都要在两种模式下各跑一遍；做转换检查时，把一种模式的输出再喂回另一种模式。按「要求的交付物」与「主要工作类型」判断，而不是按主题关键词。这些是评审用例，不是自动化断言。

@unknowssq/better-experience README · 质量评审用例：| 用例 | 草稿 / 转换 | 期望行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 简单请求 | “把这段话改得更自然。” | 两种模式都保持提示词简洁；Professional 不会平白添加角色、工作流或验收章节。 |
| 既有项目，单点修复 | “修复设置页切换主题后下拉框仍是浅色的问题。” | 保留直接的修复请求；可以引导查看仓库并做一次聚焦检查，但不搭多阶段脚手架。 |
| 显式约束 | “给报表加导出功能，只改报表模块，不增加依赖，保留现有 CSV 格式。” | 所有约束在双向模式转换中都存活，且只出现一次。 |
| 多任务实现 | “增加批量导入、失败重试和导入记录页，并补上必要测试。” | Professional 把三项交付物分开，并给出有意义的验收检查；不逐段重复同样的指导。 |
| 缺失但可查的细节 | “把用户列表加分页。” | 不要一上来就问页大小或接口形状；引导去查既有约定。 |
| 关键歧义 | “清理生产环境里不需要的数据。” | 提出聚焦的澄清问题；绝不臆造删除范围或授权。 |
| 代码与写作混合 | “修复帮助中心 Markdown 页面的代码示例，再润色周边说明。” | 主场景：coding；次场景：writing。 |
| 研究类词汇，写作类产出 | “把我提供的访谈摘录整理成一篇清晰的总结，不要查外部资料。” | 主场景：writing；没有 research 次场景。 |

@unknowssq/better-experience README · 固定模式行为：用同一段草稿复核两种模式：“优化 dsh 插件的 README.md，专业重构结构，参考官方和社区插件示例，并将项目推送至 GitHub，使插件具备被收录和官方推荐载入的条件。”

| 模式 | 期望行为 |
|---|---|
| Standard | 简洁重写，保留任务范围并说清目标；最多补一项确实有助于理解的信息，不展开通用工作流。 |
| Professional | 建模多项任务：检查项目、通过一手来源核对官方要求、区分官方规则与社区惯例、重构并检查 README，再安全推送限定范围的改动。标出未核实的条件；目标含糊、远端分歧或权限不足时停止推送。不得暗示文档重构即可保证官方收录。 |

检查两种输出是否在任务建模深度上有可见区别，同时保留 README 修改与 GitHub 推送目标。不安全或含糊的 Git 操作必须停止，不得强制推送、改动远程或丢弃无关工作。
@unknowssq/better-experience README · 固定模式行为：按维度打 0–2 分（失败 / 部分达成 / 良好），把主场景准确率与次场景的精确率、召回率分开统计。外部收录类任务另评：一手来源核实、官方规则与社区惯例的区分、未知标准是否标注为未核实。发布类任务另评：目标核实与安全中止行为。丢失硬约束或改变被要求的动作属于阻断性失败，与总分无关。

@unknowssq/better-experience README · 权限与数据：- **草稿文本**会发送到你选定的模型，重写后的文本通过宿主的草稿 API 写回输入框。
- **模型调用**消耗你的 token。每次优化是一次不带工具的模型调用，插件其余部分不会调用模型。
- **模板**从会话工作区的 `.agents/prompts` 读取，计数写入 `.agents/prompts/.usage.json`。
- **余额**通过 `remote.account.getBalance` 读取；价格是随插件发布的常量。
- **无遥测**，无分析端点，除你配置的模型提供方与账户服务外没有其他网络请求。
